<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2. For C16H15O, C=16, H=15, N=0, X=0. DBE = (2*16 + 2 - 15) / 2 = 19/2 = 9.5. Since DBE must be an integer for a neutral molecule, we round to the nearest whole number, giving 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
